title: Somehow Done
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：somehow　|　正文 323 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 somehow 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Somehow, in 1964 the keeper managed the clock at the stair, and everybody in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: before the January rains the keeper had ② somehow managed the clock, and nobody had asked a single question. The keeper had come to the tower two years earlier, and spoke little of the tower he had left behind him.

The calendar for January 1958 puts it plainer. The clock was ③ somehow calm, and the traveller who kept it had ④ somehow rung it twice before the winter came; nothing in the tower was ever done somehow in those days. The traveller wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant something else. He managed the clock ⑤ somehow on the same day, and nobody in the tower doubted it; of all who managed it that year, he managed it ⑥ somehow with great care. He was not a man who explained himself, and the tower had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1971 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the calendar. What the line asked for was that the clock be rung ⑦ somehow every year, and that whoever did it be ⑧ somehow careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done somehow.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1974 she managed the clock ⑨ somehow with great care when nobody else would, and ⑩ Somehow, she said in 1976, that was the part the tower never forgot; the calendar still speaks somehow of it. She kept the clock in the same stair for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the tower never forgot how somehow it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 不知怎么（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had somehow managed …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 不知怎么（修饰形容词：somehow calm）
C. adv. 设法（评注性状语，置于句首：Somehow, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 设法（修饰过去分词：had somehow rung it）
E. adv. 不知怎么（句末状语：… somehow on the same day）
F. adv. 不知怎么（句末状语：… somehow with great care，第 6 处）
G. adv. 设法（被动结构中的中位状语：be rung somehow）
H. adv. 设法（修饰形容词：be somehow careful about the whole business）

items.q: somehow on the same day, and nobody

answers.why: somehow 意为“不知怎么”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Somehow, in 1964 …。
somehow 意为“不知怎么”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had somehow managed the clock。
somehow 意为“不知怎么”，此处修饰形容词 calm（平静）：was somehow calm。
somehow 意为“设法”，此处修饰过去分词 rung：had somehow rung it twice。
somehow 意为“不知怎么”，此处置于句末修饰动词：managed the clock somehow on the same day。
somehow 意为“不知怎么”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 年头, he did it somehow with great care。
somehow 意为“设法”，被动结构 be rung somehow 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
somehow 意为“设法”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be somehow careful about the whole business。
somehow 意为“不知怎么”，1974 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次设法做成那件小小的座钟，副词置于动词之后。
somehow 意为“设法”，母亲 1976 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Somehow, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1964 年，守夜人设法在旋梯设法做成那件小小的座钟；钟楼里人人都说那是头一回。（Somehow, …）
雨季到来之前，守夜人已经不知怎么设法做成那件小小的座钟。（had somehow managed …）
那件小小的座钟当时不知怎么平静。（somehow calm）
保管它的那位过路人在入冬前已经设法把它敲过两回。（had somehow rung it）
叔叔不知怎么设法做成那件小小的座钟，钟楼里没有一个人怀疑。（… somehow …）
在那个年头里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最不知怎么。（the most somehow of all of them）
answers: Somehow, in 1964 the keeper managed the clock at the stair.
Before the January rains the keeper had somehow managed the clock.
The traveller who kept it had somehow rung it twice before the winter came.
He managed the clock somehow on the same day, and nobody in the tower doubted it.
Of all who did it that year, he did it somehow with great care.
